rules: Never use the job/category field as the grouping key.
Curated profiles use their saved industry label exactly; ambiguous combined labels remain Mixed industries.
Apple uses saved native genre IDs from the same metadata source as the listing; numeric IDs avoid translated-genre guessing.
YC uses exact saved tags in this mapping. Generic AI tags alone establish no industry.
One specific industry match assigns that group. Multiple specific matches assign Mixed industries; retain all matched signals.
With no specific match, broad business/productivity labels remain cross-industry; lifestyle labels remain sector unspecified; unmatched records remain unknown.
These are analyst presentation groups based on source classifications, not verified purchaser industries or a market census.
Apple genre 6004 is Sports, grouped as Sports & recreation. It does not establish healthcare use; multiple specific industry signals still map to Mixed industries.
